facts.text: I'm a farmer now. Hogs, kids and a plate of beans are my business.
facts.why: Munny never says this. On the opened quote page his lines about the farm and the kids are different, and the closest is about needing the money to give the youngsters a new start.
facts.fix: I just need the money, get a new start for them youngsters.

facts.why: Little Bill's roof leaks in the film: during Beauchamp's interview vessels are set out to catch the rain, and he says he has no more receptacles.
